title: Finite diagram arrows and relations lift after object models are chosen
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a system of qcqs schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition maps [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit cone $(X,\pi)$. Let $A$ be a finite quiver with finitely many generating arrows, $\mathrm{Paths}(A)$ its free category, $R$ a finite set, and $p_r,q_r:s_r\to t_r$ paths. Let $F:\mathrm{Paths}(A)\to\mathrm{Sch}/X$ satisfy $F(p_r)=F(q_r)$. Fix $i\in I^{\mathrm{op}}$, finite-presentation models $V_a\to D_i$ (locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated), and isomorphisms $\alpha_a:(V_a)_X\simeq F(a)$, where subscript denotes pullback [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then there are $j$, $h:j\to i$, a functor $G:\mathrm{Paths}(A)\to\mathrm{Sch}/D_j$ and a natural isomorphism $G_X\simeq F$, with $G(a)=(V_a)_j$ for every $a$ and $G(p_r)=G(q_r)$ for every $r$. No etaleness or object-descent assertion is included.

proof.text: The private finite_generators_lift lemma conjugates each generator by alpha, composes with the target pullback first projection, and applies Scheme.exists_pullback_hom_of_isLimit. IsCofiltered.wideCospan provides a common refinement for the finite type of generators. Compose each lifted scheme map with the pullback.map to its individual stage; check the structure and limit equations on the two projections. Form the Over morphisms with pullback.lift. The private pullbackComp_inv_fst and comparison_fst lemmas compute the canonical comparison via conjugateEquiv_counit, and the generator compatibility is checked by pullback.hom_ext.

Extend the resulting prefunctor by Paths.lift. Prove naturality for every path with Paths.induction: identities use functoriality, and the successor case uses the generator compatibility and the inductive hypothesis. NatIso.ofComponents then gives the comparison with F.

Naturality and the given relation equality imply that H.map(p r) and H.map(q r) have equal limit pullbacks, by cancellation of the target comparison isomorphism. Apply the private finite_morphism_equalities_lift lemma: each equality descends by Scheme.exists_pullback_fst_comp_eq_of_isLimit and pullback.hom_ext; IsCofiltered.wideCospan supplies one common stage; naturality of Over.pullbackComp transports all pulled-back equalities to the direct transition pullback. The objects satisfy the needed finite-presentation hypotheses by base change.

Base change H to the common relation stage. Use Over.pullbackComp and D.map_comp to identify its objects with the specified direct pullbacks of V. Functor.copyObj transports the functor to these objects, and Functor.isoCopyObj transports the natural comparison; pullback composition and the cone equation identify its limit pullback with F. Conjugating each relation by the objectwise isomorphisms preserves equality. Empty finite families are covered by IsCofiltered.wideCospan; identity paths are covered by Paths.induction.

lean.statement: theorem finite_diagram_lift_of_models {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (A : Type v) [Finite A] [Quiver.{v} A] [Finite (Σ a b : A, Quiver.Hom a b)] (R : Type v) [Finite R] (s t : R → Paths A) (p q : ∀ r, s r ⟶ t r) (F : Paths A ⥤ Over c.pt) (i : Iᵒᵖ) (V : A → Over (D.obj i)) (hV : ∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (V a).hom ∧ QuasiCompact (V a).hom ∧ QuasiSeparated (V a).hom) (α : ∀ a, (Over.pullback (c.π.app i)).obj (V a) ≅ F.obj a) (hR : ∀ r, F.map (p r) = F.map (q r)) : ∃ (j : Iᵒᵖ) (h : j ⟶ i) (G : Paths A ⥤ Over (D.obj j)) (β : G ⋙ Over.pullback (c.π.app j) ≅ F), (∀ a, G.obj a = (Over.pullback (D.map h)).obj (V a)) ∧ (∀ r, G.map (p r) = G.map (q r))
